title: A Word to Those Sleeping in the Parking Lot Tonight in Atlanta, Georgia
summary: Pastor Daniel Whyte III speaks directly to those spending the night in grocery store parking lots across Atlanta, Georgia.
body_html:
Pastor Daniel Whyte III shared this word during his October 9 sermon, 'Prayer, Love, and Advice for the 144,000 Homeless People in Atlanta.' Watch the full sermon here: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158.

“Many of you sleeping in the parking lot of Kroger's or some other grocery store tonight in Atlanta, Georgia.”

— Daniel Whyte III

Watch the full sermon: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158
takeaway: “I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in.” (Matthew 25:35, KJV)
